name: create_node_task_queue_events
description: Builds a sequential async task queue on EventEmitter
prompts: Create taskqueue.js exporting a class TaskQueue (module.exports = { TaskQueue }) extending require('events').EventEmitter. add(fn) enqueues an async function and returns the queue; tasks run STRICTLY one at a time in add order, starting automatically. For each task the queue emits 'result' with (index, value) when it resolves, or 'failure' with (index, error) when it rejects - a rejection must NOT stop later tasks. After the last queued task settles, emit 'drain' with an array of all resolved values (failed slots as null). Indices are 0-based add order.
